facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is headed by National Commissioner Vincent Olatunji, who spoke for it in Abuja, and over 90% of its staff are certified data protection officers.
The NDPC Act was signed into law by President Tinubu in June 2023, per the commissioner.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission operates under the Act, led by its commissioner.
The commissioner said Nigeria has over 10,000 certified data protection officers and licenses data protection compliance organisations to carry out compliance for government.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission has a National Commissioner and CEO, Vincent Olatunji.
The commissioner said the commission licenses data protection compliance organisations to carry out compliance on behalf of government, and that over 10,000 data protection officers are certified.
